# Agent permission harness — findings

13 findings across 3 workflow files — 7 defects and 6 posture records. All 13 are decided from the workflow artifact with nothing running; 1 of them would *also* be visible to an attack-replay harness pointed at the running agent, and none require one.

| Rule | Severity | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `R1-missing-referenced-script` — Referenced script absent from the repository | defect | 1 |
| `R2-static-output-delimiter` — Fixed delimiter on a workflow variable write | defect | 1 |
| `R4-unpinned-third-party-action` — Third-party action on a mutable ref in a privileged job | defect | 4 |
| `R5-inherited-write-permission` — Job inherits an undeclared write scope | posture | 5 |
| `R6-agent-holds-write-scope` — Agent step holds repository write scope | posture | 1 |
| `R7-agent-instruction-closure` — Agent instruction set exceeds its prompt input | defect | 1 |
| `R3-untrusted-expression-in-run` — Attacker-authored expression spliced into a shell script | — | 0 |

The zero rows are results too. `R3-untrusted-expression-in-run` found nothing here, and R3 in particular is the canonical GitHub Actions script-injection class — its absence is why the headline finding below is R7.

## R1-missing-referenced-script — Referenced script absent from the repository

- **`.github/workflows/opencode-high-throughput.yml` job `opencode-agent` (line 136)** — references .github/scripts/prepare-agent-prompt.sh, which is not in the repository
  - The step invokes `.github/scripts/prepare-agent-prompt.sh`. No such path exists in this checkout, and the reference is guarded (`|| true`, a `-f` test, or a discarded stderr), so its absence is silent: the fallback path runs, the job goes green, and the file continues to read as though the script were the thing being executed.
  - writer set of the reachable input: `REPO_WRITE`; privilege reached: `token:contents,id-token,pull-requests secrets:GITHUB_TOKEN,OPENCODE_API_KEY`; visible to attack replay: no

## R2-static-output-delimiter — Fixed delimiter on a workflow variable write

- **`.github/workflows/opencode-high-throughput.yml` job `opencode-agent` (line 136)** — writes non-literal content to a workflow variable file behind the fixed delimiter `PROMPT_EOF`
  - The step writes content it does not control -- a file read, a variable, or a command substitution -- into `$GITHUB_OUTPUT`/`$GITHUB_ENV` using the literal delimiter `PROMPT_EOF`. A line equal to `PROMPT_EOF` anywhere in that content closes the value early and the remainder is parsed as further assignments. Generate the delimiter per run instead.
  - writer set of the reachable input: `REPO_WRITE`; privilege reached: `token:contents,id-token,pull-requests secrets:GITHUB_TOKEN,OPENCODE_API_KEY`; visible to attack replay: no

## R4-unpinned-third-party-action — Third-party action on a mutable ref in a privileged job

- **`.github/workflows/real-estate-agent-photo-app-deploy-docs.yml` job `deploy` (line 54)** — cloudflare/wrangler-action is pinned to the mutable ref `v3`
  - `cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3` resolves through a tag or branch its owner can repoint at any commit. This step receives CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, so a moved ref is arbitrary code against that privilege. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
  - writer set of the reachable input: `ANY_USER`; privilege reached: `token:deployments secrets:CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID,CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`; visible to attack replay: no

  - writer set of the reachable input: `ANY_USER`; privilege reached: `token:id-token,pages secrets:DOCS_PASSCODE`; visible to attack replay: no

  - `pnpm/action-setup@v4` resolves through a tag or branch its owner can repoint at any commit. This step runs in a job holding id-token, pages, so a moved ref is arbitrary code against that privilege. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
  - writer set of the reachable input: `ANY_USER`; privilege reached: `token:id-token,pages secrets:DOCS_PASSCODE,VERCEL_ORG_ID,VERCEL_PROJECT_ID,VERCEL_TOKEN`; visible to attack replay: no
- **`.github/workflows/retail-pilot-intel-deploy-docs.yml` job `deploy-vercel` (line 106)** — amondnet/vercel-action is pinned to the mutable ref `v25`
  - `amondnet/vercel-action@v25` resolves through a tag or branch its owner can repoint at any commit. This step receives VERCEL_ORG_ID, VERCEL_PROJECT_ID, VERCEL_TOKEN, so a moved ref is arbitrary code against that privilege. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.

## R5-inherited-write-permission — Job inherits an undeclared write scope

- **`.github/workflows/opencode-high-throughput.yml` job `opencode-agent` (line 109)** — inherits write scopes it does not declare: contents, id-token, pull-requests
  - The job declares no `permissions:` block, so it runs with the file-level floor (contents, id-token, pull-requests). Declaring the scope on the job that needs it, and `contents: read` on the ones that do not, makes the grant a decision rather than a side effect of which file the job happens to live in.

## R7-agent-instruction-closure — Agent instruction set exceeds its prompt input

- **`.github/workflows/opencode-high-throughput.yml` job `opencode-agent` (line 109)** — agent instruction set is 21 repository files, not the 1 prompt file(s) passed to it
  - The prompt handed to this agent directs it to read and heed `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `IMPROVEMENT-PLAN.md`, `VENTURE.yaml`, `developmentprocess.tsx`, `portfolio/router/README.md` -- which resolve to 21 files in this checkout, among them `CLAUDE.md`, `portfolio/router/README.md`, `ventures/ai-engineering-academy/VENTURE.yaml`, `ventures/ai-first-markets/VENTURE.yaml`, `ventures/garmin-world-traveler-watchface/VENTURE.yaml`, `ventures/local-site-studio/AGENTS.md`, `ventures/local-site-studio/VENTURE.yaml`, `ventures/photo-editing/AGENTS.md`. Every one is an ordinary repository file with writer set REPO_WRITE, and the agent reads them while holding token:contents,id-token,pull-requests secrets:GITHUB_TOKEN,OPENCODE_API_KEY. Hardening or replaying attacks against the prompt input alone leaves this surface untested.
  - writer set of the reachable input: `REPO_WRITE`; privilege reached: `token:contents,id-token,pull-requests secrets:GITHUB_TOKEN,OPENCODE_API_KEY`; visible to attack replay: no
